name: MRL Transit
classification_notes: MICR (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition) lettering reimagined as a display type, with geometric construction, rounded strokes and monolinear weight. The inkball-derived forms and notched terminals place it firmly in the display category rather than any functional text classification.
summary: A MICR-inspired display type spanning eight widths with a variable font and vintage computing character.
description: MRL Transit reinterprets the functional letterforms of Magnetic Ink Character Recognition type, adding rounded strokes and a retro quality drawn from early computing aesthetics. It comes in eight static widths – ultra condensed to ultra expanded – plus a variable font that moves fluidly along the width axis. An alternative stylistic set introduces specular counters and exaggerated drop terminals for further variation.
foundry_blurb: Morula Type describe Transit as taking MICR's functional origins and reimagining them with a rounded, retro sensibility rooted in vintage computing. The design spans eight distinct widths with a complete alternative glyph set featuring specular counters and drop terminals. The variable version enables smooth animations along the width axis, making it suited to logos and animated titles.
